build_DPTOutputAdapter: build a DPT output adapter module to decode ViT encoder tokens into spatial feature maps for regression or segmentation
create_make_scratch: create a scratch module with four Conv2d layers to project multi-scale feature maps to a uniform output dimension
create_ResidualConvUnit_custom: create a residual convolution unit with two conv layers and optional batch normalization for feature refinement
create_FeatureFusionBlock_custom: create a feature fusion block that merges skip connections with residual conv units and upsamples output
review_DPTOutputAdapter_forward: review the DPTOutputAdapter forward method to understand how encoder tokens are reshaped, post-processed, and fused through refinement stages
